[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Removing stars from a string** [LC 2390 · Removing Stars From a String](https://leetcode.com/problems/removing-stars-from-a-string/){difficulty="Medium"}

"Closest character to the left" is the top of a stack. Strings are immutable in Python (and copying in C++), so the naive "find the star, rebuild the string without two characters" costs $O(n)$ **per star**: $O(n^2)$ in total. A list used as a stack makes each step $O(1)$.

[Solved in full in @sec-cx-p6-stars.]{.card-link}
